method: Internal repository inspection plus bounded public-web sampling; this is an observation baseline, not a comprehensive ranking study.

findings.evidence: Sampled brand search did not surface the canonical site usefully and returned strong unrelated entity collisions.
Current site repository previously inspected as a single static index page without robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical link, or Organization JSON-LD.
Current repository and live site expose article pages, NewsArticle JSON-LD, RSS/Atom/JSON feeds, sitemaps, robots, public standards/corrections, and a topic/coverage graph.
No durable Bing AI Performance / citation-grounding telemetry integration was found in the current Koios repository search.
Historical posts are discoverable via Hive/Ecency while the canonical Substack identity is not yet a settled group-wide discovery contract.
Live homepage exposes clear author identity, research subject, canonical domain, and readable descriptive content.
